employees.evidence: Our people are our greatest asset – we say it often and with good reason.

result.analyst_notes: First-person plural voice throughout, with people and clients framed first and shareholders close behind. Tone mixes absolute language (commitment is absolute, clients' interests always come first) with hedged progress claims (we have significant work to do, we believe we are on track). Much of the page is aspirational, with factual metrics like the gender pay gap reports and the Charter goal of 30 percent senior women by 2023. Distinctive wording includes we would rather be best than biggest.
